Machine learning with dataframes

skrub is a Python library to ease preprocessing and feature engineering for tabular machine learning.
We directly connect database tables to machine learning.

Effortless Tabular Learning

{% include "demo_tabular_pipeline.html" %}

Powerful Feature Engineering

Encode text and high cardinality categorical data (StringEncoder, LLMEncoder, GapEncoder, and MinHashEncoder), or extract features from dates with the DatetimeEncoder, or robustly scale and clip numerical features with the SquashingScaler.

The skrub DataOps framework

Custom train-test pipelines

  • Define a pipeline that transforms any data, from loading to the final predictor.
    • No restrictions on input data types: dataframes (with dedicated transformers), images, or anything else. Apply different transformers to specific columns with .skb.apply and selectors.
  • Keep using scikit-learn transformers and predictors in your pipeline, and export it as a learner providing fit() and predict().
  • Create reports with intermediate results and links to the source code of each estimator.

Discover the skrub DataOps →

Open an interactive report →

Leakproof cross-validation

  • Include the construction of X and y in the pipeline itself.
  • Evaluate without data leakage with the built-in cross-validation.
  • Tune data pipeline decisions, not only hyperparameters:
    • Combine and nest the choose_* functions to build extensive hyperparameter grids with no effort.
    • Explore the hyperparameter space with scikit-learn or Optuna.

Tune and validate your pipelines →
